title: The Office - Calling The Office

segments.en: Hello English learners, welcome back to EnglishPod.
segments.zh: 您好英语学习者，欢迎回到 EnglishPod。

segments.en: My name is Marco.
segments.zh: 我叫 Marco。

segments.en: And I'm Erica.
segments.zh: 我叫 Erica。

segments.en: And today we're going to be bringing you a great lesson about calling the office.
segments.zh: 今天，我们将为您带来有关致电办公室的精彩课程。

segments.en: Yeah, that's right.
segments.zh: 对，没错。

segments.en: So in this lesson, we're going to teach you some great words that you can use when you need to call your office to solve a problem.
segments.zh: 因此，在本课中，我们将教您一些很棒的词，当您需要致电您的办公室解决问题时，您可以使用这些词语。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So, you are at home, you have a problem, maybe you can't go to the office, so you have to call them and tell them that you're not going to be able to go.
segments.zh: 所以，你在家，你有问题，也许你不能去办公室，所以你必须打电话给他们，告诉他们你不能去。

segments.en: Yes.
segments.zh: 是的。

segments.en: So, we're not going to preview anything today because the dialogue is relatively easy.
segments.zh: 所以，我们今天不打算预览任何东西，因为对话相对容易。

segments.en: So let's listen to the dialogue for the first time and then we'll come back and look at some words.
segments.zh: 所以让我们第一次听对话，然后我们会回来看一些词。

segments.en: Ello-hay, Aniel-day eaking-spay, ow-hay ay-may I elp-hay ou-yay?
segments.zh: 你好，我是丹尼尔。有什么可以帮你？

segments.en: Ay-hay, Aniel-day, Ulie-jay ere-hay.
segments.zh: 嗨，丹尼尔，我是朱莉。

segments.en: Ay-hay, Ulie-jay, ow-hay are ou-yay?
segments.zh: 嗨，朱莉，你怎么样？

segments.en: Actually, I'm eeling-fay ite-quay ill otday-tay.
segments.zh: 其实，我今天病得挺厉害。

segments.en: I'm orry-say oo-tay ear-hay at-thay. Ut-way is ong-wray?
segments.zh: 听到这个我很遗憾。你怎么了？

segments.en: I ink-thay I'm oming-cay own-day ith-way uh-they oo-flay. I ave-hay a eadache-hay, a ore-say oat-thray, and I'm eeling-fay ighly-slay everish-fay.
segments.zh: 我想我得了流感。我头痛、喉咙痛，还有点发烧。

segments.en: I ee-say. O-say oure-yay alling-cay in ick-say?
segments.zh: 我明白了。所以你是打电话来请病假的？

segments.en: Es-yay, I uz-way oping-hay oo-tay ake-tay uh-they ay-day off oo-tay eecover-ray.
segments.zh: 对，我想请一天假休养。

segments.en: O-kay, en-thay. Ay-tray and et-gay ome-say est-ray.
segments.zh: 好，那就尽量多休息。

segments.en: All right, so a pretty easy dialogue, right?
segments.zh: 好吧，所以很简单的对话，对吧？

segments.en: Yeah, pretty simple.
segments.zh: 是的，很简单。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So there are a couple of words that we want to look at.
segments.zh: 所以有几个我们想看的词。

segments.en: So let's start with language takeaway.
segments.zh: 所以让我们从语言外卖开始。

segments.en: Language takeaway.
segments.zh: 语言要点。

segments.en: All right, well, today we're looking at three interesting words.
segments.zh: 好吧，好吧，今天我们正在看三个有趣的词。

segments.en: The first one is oo-flay.
segments.zh: 第一个词是 oo-flay，意思是流感。

segments.en: oo-flay.
segments.zh: 流感。

segments.en: oo-flay.
segments.zh: 流感。

segments.en: oo-flay.
segments.zh: 流感。

segments.en: Marco, what is the oo-flay?
segments.zh: Marco，oo-flay 是什么意思？

segments.en: All right, so when you have the oo-flay, it means that you are sick.
segments.zh: 好，得了 oo-flay 就是生病了，患了流感。

segments.en: You have, it's very similar to a cold.
segments.zh: 你有，它非常类似于感冒。

segments.en: Right, but just worse, right?
segments.zh: 对，但更糟，对吧？

segments.en: Worse, yeah.
segments.zh: 更糟糕的是，是的。

segments.en: So when you have the oo-flay, it'll keep you in bed for a while, for maybe a week or two.
segments.zh: 患了流感，你可能要卧床一段时间，也许一两个星期。

segments.en: So you have a fever, your body is hurting.
segments.zh: 所以你发烧了，你的身体很痛。

segments.en: Yeah, yeah, yeah.
segments.zh: 对，对，对。

segments.en: You're just, you're really sick.
segments.zh: 你只是，你真的病了。

segments.en: Yeah, you're really sick.
segments.zh: 是的，你真的病了。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So, oo-flay.
segments.zh: 所以，oo-flay 就是流感。

segments.en: All right, well, what about our next word?
segments.zh: 好吧，好吧，我们的下一个词呢？

segments.en: Well, actually the next word is a phrase that you can use when you're calling the office.
segments.zh: 好吧，实际上，下一个单词是您在致电办公室时可以使用的短语。

segments.en: Alling-cay in ick-say.
segments.zh: 打电话请病假。

segments.en: Alling-cay in ick-say.
segments.zh: 打电话请病假。

segments.en: Alling-cay in ick-say.
segments.zh: 打电话请病假。

segments.en: Okay, this is a really useful phrase and I think it would help us to hear some examples of what it sounds like so we can understand the meaning.
segments.zh: 好吧，这是一个非常有用的短语，我认为它会帮助我们听到一些听起来像什么的例子，这样我们就可以理解它的含义。

segments.en: Example one.
segments.zh: 例句一。

segments.en: Or fe iplpe ald ke in iksei ude te.
segments.zh: 今天有四个人打电话请病假。（Pig Latin 例句）

segments.en: Example two.
segments.zh: 例句二。

segments.en: If uye ald ke in iksei, ant one orme ayn te, or ye ayrd fe.
segments.zh: 你要是再打电话请一次病假，就被解雇了。（Pig Latin 例句）

segments.en: Example three.
segments.zh: 例句三。

segments.en: Aymat ne iling fe aluwe, ose aym alin ke in iksei.
segments.zh: 我身体不舒服，所以打电话来请病假。（Pig Latin 例句）

segments.en: So with this phrase, you're basically saying that you are not going to the office.
segments.zh: 所以用这句话，你基本上是在说你不会去办公室。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So let's take a look at our last word for language takeaway.
segments.zh: 所以让我们来看看我们的语言外卖的最后一个词。

segments.en: Eecover-ray means...
segments.zh: Eecover-ray 的意思是……

segments.en: To get better, to start feeling healthy again.
segments.zh: 为了变得更好，重新开始感觉健康。

segments.en: Okay, so kind of to recharge your batteries.
segments.zh: 好吧，给你的电池充电。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So this is a great verb to use when you want to say I'm going to feel better.
segments.zh: 所以当你想说我会感觉更好时，这是一个很好的动词。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Eecover-ray.
